articles.title: DeFi's new front: VerifiedX bets bitcoin's next chapter is programmable, private
articles.snippet: VerifiedX says its Bitcoin sidechain enables programmable, privacy-preserving transactions without synthetic wrappers, targeting growing institutional demand for native DeFi on the original blockchain system.

articles.title: Japan's SBI Securities, Rakuten Securities plan to offer crypto investment trusts
articles.snippet: Another 11 companies responded to a survey saying they would consider offering crypto funds once the regulatory environment becomes clear.

articles.title: A Russian stablecoin built to dodge sanctions says it can survive even if they're lifted
articles.snippet: A7A5, the Russia-linked stablecoin built to move money around banking restrictions, says faster trade settlement, yield and regional crypto infrastructure could keep it relevant even if geopolitical tensions ease.

articles.title: Crypto users are choosing juicy yields over protection, putting billions at risk of hacks
articles.snippet: DeFi insurance protocols debuted with huge ambitions during the 2020 crypto boom. But as hacks evolved and users chased yields over protection, most of the sector collapsed under the same risks it was built to cover.

articles.title: The $293 million KelpDAO hack shows why DeFi is finally being forced to grow up
articles.snippet: For protocol founders and security researchers, the incident reinforced a broader shift underway across crypto: DeFi is no longer primarily battling coding bugs. It’s battling complexity.
